field_descriptions.health_condition: Specifying the health condition(s) of a patient, medical study, or other target audience.
field_descriptions.identifier: The identifier property represents any kind of identifier for any kind of [[Thing]], such as ISBNs, GTIN codes, UUIDs etc. Schema.org provides dedicated properties for representing many of these, either as textual strings or as URL (URI) links. See [background notes](/docs/datamodel.html#identifierBg) for more details.
field_descriptions.required_gender: Audiences defined by a person's gender.
field_descriptions.required_max_age: Audiences defined by a person's maximum age.
field_descriptions.required_min_age: Audiences defined by a person's minimum age.
field_descriptions.suggested_age: The age or age range for the intended audience or person, for example 3-12 months for infants, 1-5 years for toddlers.
field_descriptions.suggested_gender: The suggested gender of the intended person or audience, for example "male", "female", or "unisex".
field_descriptions.suggested_max_age: Maximum recommended age in years for the audience or user.
field_descriptions.suggested_measurement: A suggested range of body measurements for the intended audience or person, for example inseam between 32 and 34 inches or height between 170 and 190 cm. Typically found on a size chart for wearable products.
field_descriptions.suggested_min_age: Minimum recommended age in years for the audience or user.
